annotations.title: Hold one payment against a mandate

description: Verify one payment against a mandate before it is prepared. A breach returns mandate_violation and the rule that failed. A pass still needs the named person to approve. Nothing is sent. A router key is required. The verification is recorded when the payment is prepared inside a payment run.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

agent_id.description: Optional. The agent making the payment; must match the mandate's agent.

amount.description: The payment amount, in currency, greater than zero.

cost_above_official_pct.description: Null when the gap to the official rate is not on record. Never treated as zero.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency, e.g. 'USDT'; with to, forms the corridor (e.g. USDT-ZAR).

rail.description: Optional. The rail the payment would use: bank, provider or stablecoin.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the destination currency, e.g. 'ZAR'.

name: check_payment_against_mandate
title: Hold one payment against a mandate
